title: coap/CMakeLists.txt gates coap_metrics.c on CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_METRICS, a Kconfig symbol defined nowhere
description: Codereview pass 3 (edge-cases) on jy0a (worker3): lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/CMakeLists.txt:60-62 compiles coap_metrics.c under CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_METRICS, but no 'config LICHEN_COAP_METRICS' exists anywhere under lichen/ — the source file is unreachable in every configuration. Either add the Kconfig symbol (if metrics are intended) or remove the dead gate/file reference. P4 build hygiene.
close_reason: Added the missing Kconfig symbols LICHEN_COAP_METRICS (bool, deps matching LICHEN_COAP_LOCATION: LICHEN_SENML + LICHEN_LORA_L2, default n) and LICHEN_COAP_METRICS_LOG_LEVEL to lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/Kconfig, mirroring the LICHEN_COAP_LOCATION block. coap_metrics.c is now reachable via the existing CMakeLists gate and its CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_METRICS_LOG_LEVEL resolves. Validated with kconfiglib: Kconfig parses, both symbols defined.
